notas: Copyright and trademark lawsuit filed in S.D.N.Y. (case 1:24-cv-07984). On 2025-08-21 the court denied Perplexity's motion to dismiss. The source refers to Perplexity's own and third-party web crawlers; crawler name to be confirmed.

Mastercard Agent Pay uses Agentic Tokens; AI agents must be registered and verified before they can pay on a user's behalf, and consumers control what the agent may buy. Microsoft is the first AI platform partner, with others to follow. Applies to all agent types.

Visa opened its network to AI agents that find and buy on users' behalf, using tokenized AI-ready cards and consumer-set spending limits. Named partners include Anthropic, IBM, Microsoft, Mistral AI, OpenAI, Perplexity, Samsung and Stripe. Applies to all agent types.

Lawsuit filed in San Francisco Superior Court (California). Reddit alleges Anthropic's automated bots kept accessing the site after being asked not to, and trained Claude on users' data without consent. Bot names not given in the source; to be confirmed.

Default storefront robots.txt says buy-for-me agents must not complete payment without a final review step, and points integrators to Checkout Kit. A Shopify engineer said the change "doesn't add or remove any rules": it is a comment, not an enforced rule.

First reported by The Information on 2025-07-30; Amazon did not comment. This article does not name the agents: per Search Engine Journal, Amazon's robots.txt still fully disallows GoogleAgent-Mariner and GoogleAgent-Shopping as of 2026-09-22. Agent type "nube" is based on TechCrunch (May 2025): Google moved Project Mariner to cloud virtual machines on 2025-05-20 (https://techcrunch.com/2025/05/20/google-rolls-out-project-mariner-its-web-browsing-ai-agent/). The type of GoogleAgent-Shopping is unknown.

Cloudflare de-listed Perplexity as a verified bot and added managed rules that block its stealth crawling. Cloudflare is a network provider: the block applies to its customers' sites, including free plans. Perplexity used undeclared user agents and IPs to evade no-crawl directives.
Copyright and trademark lawsuit filed in S.D.N.Y. (case 1:25-cv-07546). Alleges PerplexityBot scrapes the sites for Perplexity's answer engine and at times ignored or evaded robots.txt.

Summary (Chinese source): at the 2025 Inclusion Bund conference, Alipay launched AI Pay, a payment service for AI agents. First live in Luckin Coffee's ordering assistant Lucky AI: users order and pay by voice without leaving the chat, after identity verification. Alipay also offers a payment MCP server so agents can connect to Alipay payments. Mechanism left empty because it is a commercial partnership.

Partnership announced by Walmart: customers and Sam's Club members will be able to shop Walmart through ChatGPT using Instant Checkout. Mechanism left empty because it is a commercial partnership. Launch date to be confirmed (announced as "soon"). Agent type to be confirmed.

Lawsuit in S.D.N.Y. (case 1:25-cv-08736) against Perplexity AI and the scraping and proxy firms SerpApi, Oxylabs and AWMProxy. Cause listed as DMCA section 1201 (circumvention). The docket and the complaint do not name Perplexity's crawlers; agent name and type to be confirmed.

PayPal will adopt the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP): ChatGPT users can pay with PayPal in Instant Checkout, and PayPal merchants' catalogs reach ChatGPT in 2026 without individual integrations. Mechanism left empty because it is a commercial partnership.

Date is the effective date of the current User Agreement. Section 8.2 bans bots, crawlers, browser plugins and unauthorized automated methods; AI agents are not named specifically. See also https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a1341387

Target app inside ChatGPT announced, launching in beta the following week (exact date to be confirmed). Supports multi-item baskets, fresh food, Drive Up, Order Pickup and shipping through the shopper's Target account. Mechanism left empty because it is a commercial partnership. Agent type to be confirmed.
Date is the article's publication date; exact date of the change to be confirmed. GPTBot was already blocked. Neither Amazon nor OpenAI commented.

Copyright lawsuit in S.D.N.Y. (case 1:25-cv-10106). The Times says Perplexity uses retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to crawl the web and deliver Times content, including paywalled articles, to its users in real time, after repeated requests to stop. The complaint names PerplexityBot and Perplexity-User: https://www.nytco.com/document/nyt-perplexity-filing-dec-2025/ It mixes a crawler and a user-triggered fetcher, so agent type is left empty.

Instacart app launched inside ChatGPT, with checkout in ChatGPT built on the Agentic Commerce Protocol (payments via Stripe). Mechanism left empty because it is a commercial partnership. Agent type to be confirmed.

Summary (Chinese source): Beijing News reporters installed 23 apps on the Doubao phone (nubia M153) on 2025-12-08. Taobao, Meituan, Alipay, Pinduoduo and Maoyan could not log in; WeChat, Amap and Damai could be logged in manually but not operated by the AI; 15 apps, including JD.com, worked normally. Still unable to log in on 2025-12-10 per New Yellow River: https://www.jinantimes.com.cn/news-7-5184533.html No statement from the company; based on a reporter's test.

DoorDash app launched in ChatGPT for grocery shopping: ChatGPT builds the cart, and the purchase is completed in the DoorDash app. Live for select users at launch, expanding to all in the following weeks. Mechanism left empty because it is a commercial partnership. Agent type to be confirmed.

Copilot Checkout launched on Copilot.com, powered by PayPal: shoppers find and pay for products without leaving Copilot. PayPal merchants' catalogs become purchasable through its store sync; Ashley Furniture is named as an early retailer. Mechanism left empty because it is a commercial partnership.

Partnership announced by Walmart: a Walmart and Sam's Club shopping experience inside Gemini, built on the Universal Commerce Protocol, launching first in the U.S. Mechanism left empty because it is a commercial partnership. Launch date to be confirmed. Agent type to be confirmed.

Google launched the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), an open standard for agentic commerce co-developed with Shopify, Etsy, Wayfair, Target and Walmart. Checkout is only for eligible U.S. retailers' listings, in AI Mode in Search and the Gemini app; retailers remain the seller of record. First-party agent. Mechanism left empty because UCP is a commerce standard, not a block or permission list.

agente: Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral AI and Perplexity (Wikimedia Enterprise)
notas: Announced on Wikipedia's 25th birthday: new Wikimedia Enterprise partners, joining Google, Ecosia, Nomic, Pleias, ProRata and Reef Media. Wikimedia says tech companies that rely on Wikipedia should use it responsibly, and calls Enterprise one key way to do this. The page does not say whether or how much partners pay. Agent type to be confirmed.

Announcement, not a launch: Liverpool adopted commercetools' Agentic Commerce offering (Agent Gateway, AI Hub) so customers can discover and evaluate products in assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini or Copilot. Checkout inside the assistant is only "where supported" (via ACP), and the release says it may potentially happen. Mechanism left empty because it is a commercial partnership. Launch date and agent type to be confirmed.

Effective date of the updated User Agreement (posted 2026-01-20). Bans "buy-for-me agents, LLM-driven bots, or any end-to-end flow that attempts to place orders without human review" unless eBay gives prior express permission. Per Ars Technica, eBay had already added a "Robot & Agent Policy" to its robots.txt in December 2025: https://arstechnica.com/information-technology/2026/01/ebay-bans-illicit-automated-shopping-amid-rapid-rise-of-ai-agents/

Amazon sued in November 2025 under the CFAA and CDAFA; the district court granted a preliminary injunction in March 2026 (exact day to be confirmed). Comet runs locally on the user's machine. The Ninth Circuit vacated the injunction on 2026-08-04.

Alibaba connected its own Qwen App to the full Taobao and Tmall catalog and added a Qwen-powered shopping assistant inside the Taobao app (China). First-party agent: Alibaba owns both Taobao and Qwen. Taobao is also among the apps that declined Doubao Phone Assistant (see the 2026-10-14 row). Agent type to be confirmed.

Summary (Chinese source): on Meituan's Q1 2026 earnings call, CEO Wang Xing said the partnership between Meituan's AI assistant Xiaomei and Tencent's Yuanbao would launch soon, letting users order food delivery and other local services from Yuanbao. He said serving AI agents ("To A") is becoming as important as serving consumers and merchants. Announcement; launch date to be confirmed. Mechanism left empty because it is a commercial partnership.

Summary (Chinese source): WeChat published guidelines for developers to join its AI ecosystem on 2026-06-08 (in internal testing); developers choose whether to join. JD.com, Meituan, Ctrip and Didi said they are joining, so WeChat's AI agent can call their mini programs. Meituan was in the first internal test group; users will be able to call Meituan food delivery and other local services through WeChat's agent. Mechanism left empty because it is a commercial integration.

Summary (Chinese source): the AI version of Alipay, A-Bao, was released on 2026-06-16 as an invite-only test; users can switch between the AI and classic versions. First-party agent. Per Huxiu (2026-09-28), merchants can expose services via MCP or Skills; for the rest, A-Bao reads the screen and taps through mini programs once the user authorizes it, and payments need separate user confirmation: https://m.huxiu.com/article/4894229.html

Confirmed by an Amazon spokesperson. Enforced with a block notice shown to the agent, not via robots.txt. Users saw: "Continued access by an unauthorized AI agent violates Amazon's Conditions of Use". Muse runs in a cloud virtual machine with its own browser.

First user report on X; complaints spread on 2026-10-15. A user reported the notice: "Continued access by an unauthorized AI agent violates Amazon's Conditions of Use". Amazon has not confirmed or commented. Musk replied: "Maybe we should start a competitor to Amazon". Agent type per xAI: Grok Bot runs on its own cloud computer (https://x.ai/news/introducing-grok-bot, https://docs.x.ai/grok-bot/computer-and-apps). Second source: https://finance.yahoo.com/small-business/articles/elon-musk-wants-start-amazon-220000094.html

Applies to all Williams-Sonoma Inc. brands, including Pottery Barn. Customers were emailed the week of the article; effective date to be confirmed. Automated tools must identify themselves. No specific agent named, so it applies to all agent types. The company did not comment.

plataforma: WeChat, Taobao, Honor of Kings and 148 other apps
notas: Apps opted out through Doubao's Screen Automation Execution Protocol (SAEP) permission list. 151 apps declined permission (65 Tencent, 23 Alibaba, 14 Kuaishou, 11 Meituan). The list was announced by Doubao and is updated weekly, so the count may change.

Applies to Walmart and Sam's Club. New Terms for AI Agents, Agent Profiles (launching within a month) and the Walmart Agent Gateway, which uses MCP (Model Context Protocol) and is in beta for companies and developers. Customers approve each purchase or set a spending limit; agents get no payment card data and must not act beyond what the shopper intends. Agents that break the terms will be blocked. Applies to all agent types.
